name: Shu Yun, the Silent Tempest
description: The youthful-looking, ancient leader of the Jeskai, a ghostfire warrior who collects secret knowledge with disciples in the Ojutai catacombs.

relations.quote: Shu Yun, the Silent Tempest, is the leader of the Jeskai.
